names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 7 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Ρουφίνος ο Διάκονος», with the rank word and the order left off.

Read out of the title on the first name link behind the three-part line for 7 апреля ст. ст., name page 1890, «Руфин, диакон, сщмч.», with the office word and the rank abbreviation left off. The calendar gives him no toponymic and no by-name, so the bare forename is the whole of the form it prints; no folder holds it. The name link calls him сщмч., a hieromartyr, where the day’s own line heads the three «Мчч.» and this folder carries `deacon` and `martyr`; `types` is untouched and both readings are in the life.

death.note: saint.gr's whole account of him in its own voice, as the folder's own life quotes it: «Ο Άγιος Ρουφίνος ο Διάκονος μαρτύρησε επί της βασιλείας του Δεκίου (249 - 251 μ.Χ.) αφού τον έσφαξαν με μαχαίρι».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 7 апреля ст. ст. — «Мчч. Руфина диакона, Акилины и с ними 200 воинов (ок. 310).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Ρουφίνος ο Διάκονος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It gives no year of death, only «επί της βασιλείας του Δεκίου (249 - 251 μ.Χ.)», and no `dates` were taken from a reign. The same notice from Laura Codex 170 stands on his page, on Aquilina's and on that of the two hundred martyrs of Sinope, all three listed on 7 April; the page prints no hymn for him.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
